rules: Frontmatter is the first thing in every note.
tags has at most three values: type/<type>, one lifecycle/<active|stale|archived>, one domain/<project|frontend|data|ops|research>.
source_commit is the HEAD SHA the note was synced against.
Use relative Markdown links only; wikilinks are banned.
Follow 00-START/MAINTENANCE-PROTOCOL.md section 6 for banned literal strings in Markdown.

folder_map.00-START: Entry point, maintenance protocol and authoritative source map.
folder_map.10-STATE: Current state, contradictions, release evidence, git position and gap register.
folder_map.20-DIRECTION: Vision, task register, decisions and wave status.
folder_map.30-SYSTEM: Architecture, API, data model, methodology, deployment and data-release procedure.
folder_map.40-FRONTEND: Design contract, stack and tokens, and frontend QA results.
folder_map.50-RESEARCH: Data enrichment, source research and the research log.
folder_map.60-EVIDENCE: Dated audit, review, gap-analysis and verification evidence.
folder_map.70-ARCHIVE: Historical snapshots retained for history only; never override active notes.
folder_map.Daily Notes: Date-stamped daily notes named YYYY-MM-DD (automatic creation off; created on first use).
folder_map.Templates: New-note templates: State-Note, Task, Decision, Daily.
folder_map._generated: Machine-written notes owned by scripts/vault_sync.py; never hand-edit.
folder_map..obsidian: Obsidian UI state; per-machine workspace and cache files are gitignored.

generated_notes.description: Top-level project folders, recursive file counts and purpose, from git ls-tree at HEAD.
Python test-file inventory with @test and def test_ counts from HEAD versions.
API route decorators extracted from backend/routers/api.py and backend/main.py at HEAD.
Sorted git tags plus the content of data/latest-release.txt at HEAD.
Branch, HEAD SHA, ahead/behind versus origin/main, dirty flag and HEAD commit date.

generator.source_of_truth: git objects at HEAD (git ls-tree / git show HEAD:<path>), not the working tree
generator.determinism: Sorted collections, LF endings, final newline, HEAD commit date; no wall-clock timestamps.

update_ritual: Run `git status` and capture the working-tree state before touching anything.
Make the changes in hand-written notes only; never edit files under _generated/.
Run `python3 scripts/vault_sync.py` to regenerate derived content.
Update the hand-written notes to match, recording the reason for each change.
Run `python3 scripts/vault_sync.py --check` plus `git diff --exit-code` to prove there is no residual drift; if it fails, stop and do not claim the vault is current.
Commit code and vault changes together.
